svg.title: Proposed architecture for active single-mode fiber alignment
svg.desc: The laser passes through an input pickoff and power monitor, coupling optics, and a single-mode fiber. A mode-clean measurement path feeds a photodiode. Before the fiber, calibrated near-field and far-field sensing observes position and angle. The controller receives spatial features and input and output power, then commands an XYZ and tip-tilt stage. An optional facet or residual-light camera is an exploratory channel whose usefulness must be validated. This is a proposed arrangement, not implemented hardware support.
svg.text: Spatial sensing supports acquisition; guided power sets the final alignment objective.
